developments:
The base carries no position at the window's opening. The census is [designed as a register-based exercise building central statistical registers of buildings, households, individuals and establishments by matching electronic field enumeration against digital registers and state databases, keyed on the unified national property number, with the property-wealth map and secure electronic data exchange to be finalised before a presidential decree authorises the count](2026-07-20-youm7-pm-census-2027-implementation).

The exchange is a precondition of the census rather than a by-product of it, and no data-protection regulator role is named in the design. The property number it keys on comes from a law whose implementing decree has not been made, so the census depends on an identifier the state has not yet commenced.

summary: A [Senate proposal for a national labour-market data platform was examined by a joint committee](2026-07-28-masrawy-national-labour-market-data-platform-egypt), alongside a ministry platform of its own.
developments:
The base carries no position at the window's opening. A [proposal for a national platform integrating databases and forecasting future skills demand was welcomed by the minister, who pointed to the ministry's own forthcoming digital labour platform](2026-07-28-masrawy-national-labour-market-data-platform-egypt).

No launch date, budget, governing instrument or lead body is established for either, and the two are not stated to be the same thing. It is the only proposal on this ledger to build a statistical product out of administrative data, and it arrives as two parallel intentions rather than one.

summary: A [trilateral memorandum with Japan covers satellite rainfall data for Nile basin monitoring and flood-risk modelling](2026-08-02-egypt-japan-ai-satellites-water-management).
developments:
The base carries no position at the window's opening. A memorandum with two Japanese ministries covers [technical missions, joint research and the application of artificial intelligence and digital models to monitoring water structures and reducing flood risk, with the intention of using a Japanese satellite rainfall product to monitor rainfall across Nile basin states and improve hydrological forecasting](2026-08-02-egypt-japan-ai-satellites-water-management).

No money, implementation date or named system is stated, and the instrumentation targets are old physical structures, the barrages first. It is the only use of satellite data of any kind on this ledger.

summary: A [vendor named the country among the first eight for free student subscriptions to its artificial-intelligence tier](2025-09-22 Google plans to build four subsea cable connectivity hubs for Africa).
developments:
The offer did not exist at the window's opening. 2025-09-22 - a [company-announced free one-year subscription for college students was to begin in the coming weeks in this and seven other African countries](2025-09-22 Google plans to build four subsea cable connectivity hubs for Africa); no confirmation of launch, uptake figure or end date is held.

It is a company announcement, and the offer is demand generation for a paid tier. Beyond it the base holds one edge cache in Cairo and one vendor partnership on Mediterranean cable capacity - so the United States relationship here runs through commercial infrastructure rather than through any government instrument.

summary: The country [appears in an eleven-country mapping of Chinese-supplied smart-city surveillance](2026-03-01 Smart City Surveillance in Africa (IDS 2026)) with no contract or figure held.
developments:
A [United States firm's safe-city package was recorded as adopted in the country in 2023, with Chinese supply not separately established](2023-09-27-ids-mapping-supply-surveillance-technologies-africa-1bn). The country is now [one of eleven where Chinese firms were found to supply smart-city surveillance equipment, and one of the states where Chinese banks financed such systems, with the New Administrative Capital listed against multiple named vendors](2026-03-01 Smart City Surveillance in Africa (IDS 2026)), and [named again in continental reporting](2026-04-04 Chinese surveillance rolled out in Africa ZTE, Hikvision, Huawei at the helm). No Egyptian contract, value, camera count or command-centre detail is held.

Commercially the relationship is documented: a [public cloud region has operated since 2024 with data held in country, the company stating regulator certification, Tier 3 licensing and adherence to financial-regulator residency requirements, and running a Cairo summit in June 2026 aimed at financial-sector migration](2026-06-15-huawei-cloud-egypt-fintech-localisation-techafricanews). It is entirely company-reported.

summary: The minister [discussed cloud sovereignty with a European vendor's regional president](2026-03-31-egypt-sap-cloud-ai-outsourcing-techafricanews); no instrument is signed.
developments:
The base carries no statement of the country's position on sovereignty over data hosted on European vendor platforms at the window's opening. 2026-03-31 - talks covered [expanding outsourcing operations and investment, cooperation on cloud computing to support the push for greater sovereignty over data and applications hosted on those platforms, artificial-intelligence rollout, and a joint study of labour-market demand](2026-03-31-egypt-sap-cloud-ai-outsourcing-techafricanews); no agreement, value or timetable is stated.

It is the only source that touches the country's digital relationship with a European counterparty at instrument level, and it establishes talks only - in a year when the country ran the largest spectrum award on this ledger, hosted a continental settlement system and chaired two Arab working groups.

summary: The two industry ministers [agreed a joint study of priority sectors and discussed linking their payment systems](2026-08-07-industry-minister-announces-egyptian-indian-industrial-integration-platform).
developments:
The base held no source at all on this relationship at the window's opening. 2026-08-07 - on the margins of a ministerial meeting the two ministers [agreed a joint study of priority sectors for industrial and investment integration, covering market needs, value chains, joint manufacturing, incentives and tariff and non-tariff barriers, with financial technology among the named priority sectors; they discussed linking the two countries' payment systems and settling bilateral trade in local currencies, and one side proposed an industrial integration platform matching companies on joint production, component exchange and supplier development](2026-08-07-industry-minister-announces-egyptian-indian-industrial-integration-platform).

The payment-system linkage is stated as under discussion only: no central bank, operator or payment rail is named on either side, and no instrument, value or date is given.

summary: Identity on the tax authority's real estate transactions application is verified using artificial-intelligence techniques ([statement](2026-08-29-egypt-etax-ai-identity-verification)).
developments: Identity on the tax authority's real estate transactions application is verified using artificial-intelligence techniques ([statement](2026-08-29-egypt-etax-ai-identity-verification)). No accuracy or fallback route for a failed verification is stated.

developments: The financial regulator granted preliminary approval for two further technology projects to enter its regulatory sandbox ([approval](2026-09-01-techafricanews-egypt-fra-fintech-sandbox)).
